definition: Euclidean norm(y10-y9)/norm(y9), flattened scalar components, no denominator floor. Waveform concatenates all 80 phase pairs before taking norms.
output_precision: Float32 DataOut samples including repeated cell vertices
phase_pairing: 80 actual PVD entries with 13.6<t9<=14.4, t10=t9+0.8; both literal 13.6 entries excluded; no filename-index formula
run_scope: Ten forcing cycles 7.2–15.2 s, ordinary startup with a read-only output observer; final two cycles at tight tolerance. Public-source 50 ms replay is a separate result.
scope: Diagnostic64 ten-cycle solid point-sample comparison only; not independently grown small/medium/large, not physical or mass-weighted FE norms, not all FE coefficients, not an IDA acceptance/original-F certificate
